description: Four voltage sources on sliders, each with its own range and its own CV input

params.text: Sets where the output falls between the MIN and MAX voltages
Pushes all four sliders to the top of their travel at once
Pushes all four sliders to the bottom of their travel at once
Sets the voltage the slider sends at the bottom of its travel, 0V to 10V before the range switch is applied
Sets the voltage the slider sends at the top of its travel, 0V to 10V before the range switch is applied
Shifts that slider's range down by 5V, turning a 0V to 10V range into -5V to +5V

inputs.text: Added to the slider position, 10V being the whole travel, and the sum is held inside the slider's own range

outputs.text: The voltage the slider has been set to, between the MIN and MAX values with the range switch applied
